description: Radzionków: Ewidencja dróg publicznych is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Radzionków. Zbiór danych obejmuje drogi publiczne w gminie. Wykaz zawiera m.in. numer, kategorię i klasę drogi, długość i opis jej przebiegu (np. nazwę ulicy) oraz ew. dane nt. nawierzchni czy zarządcy drogi. Coverage: Radzionków. The publisher named on the listing is Radzionków. Its keywords include drogi, rodzaj drogi, odśnieżanie, zatoki autobusowe, nawierzchnia, klasa dróg. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2025-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
